summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow geothermal deposits to qualify for the same tax benefits as oil and gas, specifically permitting the amortization of geological and geophysical expenditures and exempting working interests in geothermal properties from passive activity loss limitations.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to extend existing tax benefits for oil and gas exploration and development to geothermal deposits. By allowing amortization of geological and geophysical expenditures and providing an exception to passive loss limitations for geothermal properties, it effectively lowers the tax burden for companies investing in geothermal energy, thus reducing tax revenue.
